description: Header file defining the FileID class for generating unique file identifiers, including methods for MD5 hashing and Mach-O file identification.

classes.name: FileID
classes.description: Class for generating unique identifiers for files, supporting MD5 hashing and Mach-O specific identification.

methods.name: FileID
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the FileID object with a file path.

methods.name: FileIdentifier
methods.description: Generates a 16-byte MD5 hash of the file's contents.

methods.name: MachoIdentifier
methods.description: Generates a Mach-O specific identifier based on CPU type/subtype or file contents.

methods.name: ConvertIdentifierToString
methods.description: Converts a 16-byte identifier into a UUID string format.
